messages.subject: Project Falcon - Lead Investor side letter
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

On the side letter, we need: MFN against other investors in this round, enhanced information rights (quarterly board packs), pro rata participation and a right of first offer on founder secondaries. Can you reflect these in the draft side letter?

Marcus Pell
